svg.title: The isolated evaluation boundary
svg.desc: Separate the container from external network access with a continuous barrier. Show no peer-channel socket or direct connection; the next panel must introduce a distinct permitted affordance. Use the independent evaluation container boundary geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships.
